notes.zh-CN: macOS 输入框新增截图按钮：拖拽框选屏幕区域，截图作为图片加入输入框。同时修复打开会话时对话刻度先高亮旧消息、再跳到最新一条的问题。macOS universal 为开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，可在团队已注册设备上安装。
notes.en: New screenshot button in the macOS composer: drag over an area of the frozen screen to attach it as a picture. Also fixes the conversation rail highlighting an older message before jumping to the newest when a conversation opens. macOS universal is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
